description: Explicit drug disclosures; identity cards never expand into these sections.
title: DrugSection
x-enum-descriptions: All native identity cross-references and product links, mechanically paged.
Native CIViC therapy evidence and profile context.
One exact native label heading; label replies also name the application numbers and recent major changes.
Native application and product history rows.

Native DDInter partner rows and levels; five rows per default page, with explicit section limits preserved. `levels` counts pairs per level across every page. DDInter's published files carry a level per pair and no management or mechanism text; `next` offers a search for the drug's openFDA label, whose drug_interactions section has that text.
One row per market (Drugs@FDA, EMA, WHO prequalification), each from its own source; takes a name and no source.
